## Evidence

Add a redacted screenshot or a reviewed support bundle if helpful. Inspect the bundle before attaching it. Do not upload cookies, `.ROBLOSECURITY` tokens, Keychain exports, authentication headers, private launch URLs or unreviewed raw Roblox logs.

## Relevant settings

Mention applicable engine profile, mods, account switching, Discord presence, notifications or experimental display options. Do not include account credentials.
